texts.error.floppy_rejected: Geartowns could not load the floppy disk '%1'.
texts.error.model_not_emulated: Geartowns does not emulate this model.

texts.firmware.free.about: The Free FM Towns Project's free replacement ROMs, from the CompROM folder of github.com/captainys/FreeTOWNSOS. They run the Model 1/2 only.
texts.firmware.hr.about: Dumped from an FM Towns II HR you own (fmtownshr set in MAME). The HG, UR run on it too.
texts.firmware.marty.about: Dumped from an FM Towns Marty you own (fmtmarty2 set in MAME).
texts.firmware.model12.about: Dumped from an FM Towns Model 1 or 2 you own (fmtowns set in MAME).
texts.firmware.ux.about: Dumped from an FM Towns II UX you own (fmtownsux set in MAME). The 1F/2F, 10F/20F, CX, UG run on it too.
texts.firmware.v10.about: Dumped from an FM Towns II MX, MF or Fresh you own (fmtownsftv set in MAME). The ME, MA, MX, MF/Fresh run on it too.
texts.setting.bootdevice.about: The drive the machine starts from. Auto tries the CD, then the floppy drives, as the system ROM does. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.cpumhz.about: The processor's clock. Auto takes the model's own, or the game database's for a game it knows. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.fpu.about: Whether a floating-point unit (an 80387 or a 487SX) is fitted. Auto fits one when the game database asks for it. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.freetownsroms.about: Run the Model 1/2 on the Free FM Towns Project's ROMs (from captainys/FreeTOWNSOS) instead of Fujitsu's. They are free; many games do not run on them. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.model.about: Which FM Towns the machine is. Each model needs the firmware of its own set. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.porta.about: What is plugged into the first game port. Auto takes the game database's choice for a game it knows, else a pad (the Marty's own pad on a Marty). It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.portb.about: What is plugged into the second game port. Auto takes the game database's choice for a game it knows, else a mouse. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.rammb.about: How much main memory the machine has. Auto takes the model's own, or the game database's for a game it knows. A size the model cannot have becomes the nearest one it can. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.speedmode.about: The speed setting the 486 models keep in their CMOS. Auto turns it on for a game the database knows wants it. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.slot.cdrom.help: CD images: a .cue sheet with its tracks, an .iso or a .chd. The first is in the drive at power on; the Next CD button changes to the next one.
texts.slot.floppy.help: Floppy disk images (.d77, .d88, .hdm, .xdf, .img, .mfm). The first is in drive 1 at power on; the Next Floppy Disk button puts the next one in drive 1. What a game writes stays in the machine and its savestates, and the files are never changed.
